versions.changelog:
huo15-dingtalk-connector-pro v1.0.0 – Initial release

- Custom DingTalk OpenClaw connector based on version 0.8.12.
- Integrates with huo15-memory-evolution memory system.
- Supports AI Card streaming responses, session management (persistence, isolation, auto-new on timeout).
- Enables rich media reception, audio messaging, and DingTalk document API.
- Includes multi-agent routing functionality.
